plain.what: Reconciles Paystack charges, updates ledger, renders PDF invoices, and sends invites.
plain.when: A customer completes a payment via Paystack checkout.
plain.result: Accounting books stay 100% balanced and clients are onboarded instantly.
plain.saves: About 15 minutes of manual bookkeeping per transaction

toolNotes.n8n: Best choice: validates cryptographic Paystack signatures directly inside an n8n Code node.
toolNotes.make: Good webhook handling; generating dynamic PDF binaries requires 3rd-party integration credits.
toolNotes.zapier: Requires multiple Zaps or expensive paths to handle reconciliation, PDF, and chat invites.
